newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhstan cenbank cuts refinancing rate to 30 pct.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhstan cenbank cuts refinancing rate to 30 pct.

text.p: Kazakhstan's National Bank cut its refinancing rate to 30 percent annual with effect from September 9 from 32 percent, a bank official said on Wednesday.
The National Bank cut the rate following a fall in inflation to 0.7 percent in August from 1.8 percent in July, Irina Moiseyeva, deputy head of the bank's statistics department told Reuters.
The National Bank also cut its rate on Lombard credits to 35 percent annual from 37 percent, she said.
